content.name: Crystal Ball
entries: This crystal ball is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the {@spell scrying} spell (save {@dc 17}) with it.

content.name: Crystal Ball
entries: The typical crystal ball, a very rare item, is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the {@spell Scrying|SRD52} spell (save {@dc 17}) with it.
